title: Site-Care Plan Elections under Community Rules & Site Care
content:
These clauses govern how a Community Rules & Site Care plan is chosen, charged and changed.

## Clauses

1. **Opening plan.** A plan record opens on the lease move-in date on the Self-Maintained Site unless the resident chose another plan at signing. Choosing or changing a plan is the resident's own election.
2. **Availability.** The plan chosen must be one whose entry gate admits the site's community; the Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan is offered only at Cedar Hollow and Conestoga Meadows.
3. **Plan fee.** The plan fee is charged on the plan fee due day of each month the plan is in force and is not prorated; a plan starting mid-month is first charged on the first day of the following month.
4. **Status.** A plan is changed only while the plan record is enrolled, as its status shows in the system's records.
5. **Effective date and frequency.** A change takes effect on the first day of the first month that begins at least the plan-change notice period (in calendar days) after the request. No more than the plan's permitted number of changes may take effect in the trailing 12 months, counted as the plan elections on the record whose effective date falls within the 12 calendar months ending on, and including, the requested effective date, the requested change included.
6. **Minimum term.** A plan may be lowered or dropped only after its minimum term, counted from the last plan change date — the date the current plan took effect, which is the move-in date for the plan held since enrollment. The term is counted in calendar months from that date, and the plan may be lowered from the first month that begins on or after the day the term completes.
7. **Snow season.** During the snow-season months a plan that includes snow removal may not be changed to one without it. Moving up to a higher plan is never restricted by the minimum term or the snow season.

## Boundary cases on the effective date

Hypothetical requests, using the 15-day notice period the plan schedule shows for every plan:

| Request date | First day of the next month | Days from request to that day | Change takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 April | 1 May | 15 | 1 May |
| 17 April | 1 May | 14 | 1 June |

## Boundary cases on the minimum term

| Hypothetical record | Term completes | Earliest month a lowering may take effect |
|---|---|---|
| 3-month term, last plan change 1 March | 1 June | June (1 June) |
| 3-month term, plan chosen at signing, move-in 15 March | 15 June | July (1 July) |

A lowering effective 1 May on the first record is not permitted; on the second record a lowering effective 1 June is not permitted, because June began before the term completed.

## Hypothetical count of changes

A record shows elections effective 1 February 2026 and 1 June 2026, and the plan permits 2 changes in 12 months. A change requested to take effect 1 January 2027 would be the third election in the 12 calendar months ending on that date and may not take effect; a change requested to take effect 1 March 2027 is the second election in its window, the February 2026 election having fallen outside it.
